FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A25
The permit age with a driver training course is 15, while the permit age through the knowledge exam without a course is 15½, so the course path starts half a year sooner. [A25]
Why it matters: group_hint permit-eligibility; prereq_hint WDL number (sec01-F08); difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F09, sec01-F10.
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A25
The permit itself lasts 1 year, but the knowledge exam score lasts 2 years, so the two expiry periods must not be swapped. [A25]
Why it matters: group_hint validity-periods; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F11.
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A26
Teen applicants ages sixteen to seventeen must complete at least forty hours of day driving and ten hours of night driving with a licensed driver who has three or more years of experience, attested to by a parent, guardian, or responsible adult [A26].
Why it matters: group_hint supervised-practice; prereq_hint sec01-F12; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-R04, sec01-F14.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A28
An adult age eighteen or older choosing the permit option passes the knowledge exam, gets a permit, practices driving with a licensed driver who has five or more years of experience, and then passes the skills exam [A28].
Why it matters: group_hint supervised-practice; prereq_hint sec01-F20; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-R03.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A26
The 40 daytime plus 10 nighttime practice hours add up to the 50 hours that the parent or guardian certifies on the authorization form. [A26]
Why it matters: group_hint supervised-practice; prereq_hint sec01-F14; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F16.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A28
In the first 6 months of an intermediate license no passenger under 20 is allowed except immediate family, whereas afterwards up to 3 such passengers are allowed. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint intermediate-restrictions; prereq_hint sec01-F21; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F22, sec01-F23.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A28
The passenger limit age is under 20, but the night-hours escort must be a parent, guardian or licensed driver at least 25, so the two ages answer different questions. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint intermediate-restrictions; prereq_hint sec01-F24; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F22, sec01-F24.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A29
A second intermediate violation brings a 6-month suspension or suspension until 18, whichever ends first, while a third suspends the license all the way to 18. [A29]
Why it matters: group_hint intermediate-penalties; prereq_hint sec01-F26; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F26.
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: FXP0030
An agricultural permit allows farm-work driving in a set area with no minimum age, but unlike the instruction permit it does not count toward a first license [FXP0030] [A29].
Why it matters: group_hint permit-types; prereq_hint sec01-F21; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F29, sec01-F30.
Source: [FXP0030 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A27
The in-person temporary license lasts 45 days, while the online receipt also acts as a temporary license but cannot be used as identification because it has no photo. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint issuance-logistics; prereq_hint sec01-F18; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec01-F18, sec01-F19.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A20
A licensed adult newcomer gets 30 days to switch to a Washington license, while a newcomer under 18 must enter the intermediate license system instead. [A20]
Why it matters: group_hint new-residents; prereq_hint sec01-F03; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F04, sec01-F06.
Source: [A20 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0020]
